title: Tiropita Greek Cheese Pie
description: A traditional Greek pastry filled with feta cheese and herbs, perfect for a satisfying snack or light meal.
instructions: Thaw phyllo dough according to package instructions
Mix feta cheese, Greek yogurt, dill, salt, and black pepper in a bowl
Layer phyllo dough in a baking dish, brushing with oil between layers
Pour cheese mixture into the center of the phyllo dough
Fold the phyllo dough over the cheese mixture, pressing edges to seal
Brush top with oil and bake for 30-40 minutes, or until golden brown
Let cool for 10-15 minutes before serving
